newsitem.title: USA: General Instrument to offer Interactive Channel.
newsitem.headline: General Instrument to offer Interactive Channel.

text.p: General Instrument Corp said Thursday it will offer the Interactive Channel's programming services as part of an agreement with Source Media Inc.

General Instrument will provide Interactive Channel services through its advanced analog and digital set-top terminals. The programming includes local news, weather, multimedia shopping, music samples and residential and business telephone listings. Source Media owns the Interactive Channel and produces some of the multimedia programming.
General Instrument develops systems for the delivery of video, voice and data programming.
Its stock closed down 1/8 Thursday at 22-1/8.
